goal: Select the region where the measurement target is most visible in the input camera image, measure that region as a 3x3 grid, then preprocess the spectra, analyze the major peaks, and produce a result report.

sample_context.visual_features: Small grain-like particles distributed across the field of view on a light background.

execution_summary.trajectory: Started camera stream -> identified target area in image -> moved to center -> previewed 3x3 grid -> executed scan with autofocus at center -> preprocessed spectra (baseline/norm) -> analyzed average spectrum.
execution_summary.outcome: Successfully mapped a 3x3 region; identified dominant silicon-like signal.

lesson: When targeting small particles on a silicon substrate, if only the 520 cm-1 peak is visible across a grid scan, the target may be transparent to Raman or composed of the same material as the substrate.

system_metrics.metrics: Peak at 511 cm-1 detected; SNR high for substrate peak.
